release_notes:
BSF-INTEL Version 2.0.1 Patch Release.
- CRITICAL FIX: Corrected PLC Force Sensor port from 502 to 4001 (IP: 192.168.0.1).
- NEW: Added editable Port Number field in the PLC COM Setting dialog (below IP Address).
- FIX: Network scanner now probes the user-specified port instead of the hardcoded Modbus port 502.
- FIX: Prevents connectivity failure to Force Sensor (Fx, Fy, Fz) caused by wrong default port.
- Both IP Address and Port Number are now fully configurable per device and saved persistently.
